posts.en:
dsh-expert-mode is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.3.0, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 11 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. New: Three-Anchor constraint (recall/convergence/anti-drift per turn) and Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert). Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e413694ef21a213b8bdf.html
